telegram-platform.note: the probe reads the vendored probes as bot source until the real bot exists; reported as pack feedback

observability.note: SPEC-031 shipped the SLO declaration, the alert unit and the memory watch, and lifted six of the seven rows SPEC-032 R8 deferred to the observability issue. obs.slo-declared asks an SLO of every long-running unit that runs deckstreakd, since the probe reads the one binary's roles as one HTTP service; the bot's unit has none, and its SLO waits for its traffic measured on the host (#42)

durable-services.note: the backup rows judge the daily backup, its offsite copy and the restore drill, which the backups issue builds (SPEC-032 R8)

cjk-typography.note: language-mentors' two composed rows judge mentor texts, which arrive with the readings screen

privacy-gdpr.note: defaults-private judges the default settings file, which the settings screen ships (SPEC-021 R9)

ux-laws.note: built into phxd; run by scripts/box-packs.sh (ADR-004)

box.note: scripts/box-packs.sh runs these packs on the maintainer's box (ADR-004, ADR-030). Each red row a pack is expected to show on the tree names the open issue that builds that row's subject; a pack that examines nothing names the issue after which it examines a row.

cyber-pipeline.note: the ws rows are web-security's, and its note says why ws.csp-script-strict is red; no planned SPEC writes the threat model cp.threat-model-trace reads, so #60, which brings every phxd pack to green, owns it

greenfield.note: it reads the notice markers in the verbatim AGPL text's own appendix (LICENSE, LICENSES/), which may not be changed; a re-pinned probe settles it (#60)

ledger-sqlite.note: the five blocking rows run phoenix-v2's own cargo tests, which the pack's SKILL.md says a consuming repository cannot run at all; #60 decides how they read here

seo-pipeline.note: it verifies the built landing page, which no commit holds yet

ui-styles.note: every row is catalog-only, so every walk examines none by the pack's design

vibecode-polish.note: public-site polish: the landing page builds its subject

web-launch.note: the public-site rows wait for the landing page (#59); html-lang reads the Mini App's source template, whose lang is Paraglide's placeholder until the page renders, so only a pack change settles it (#60)

web-security.note: the Caddy block's served policy carries frame-ancestors, object-src and base-uri and, by design, no script sources: the page's own meta policy carries them with its build's hashes (SPEC-028 R14), which the probe does not read, so ws.csp-script-strict judges the served policy alone (#60)

proxy-client-scan.note: it examines no settings document until the agent's settings template lands
